newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola Bottling sees Q2, Q3 rebound.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola Bottling sees Q2, Q3 rebound.

text.p: Coca-Cola Bottling Co Consolidated said its first-quarter results, including net income falling to $0.01 per share, do not constitute a trend indicative of the rest of the year.
The company said it historically earns less than five percent of its profits during the first quarter.
Also, additional interest expense from a share repurchase program which hurt first quarter results will have less impact on the second and third quarters, the company said.

Coca-Cola Bottling's first quarter results were down from the $0.10 per share in net income it reported for the first quarter a year ago. The company attributed the decline primarily to an increase in interest expense from higher debt balances.
